# List available commands
default:
    @just --list

# Install the cargo tools the recipes below use
install-tools:
    cargo install cargo-nextest cargo-llvm-cov cargo-machete cargo-mutants cargo-deny typos-cli zizmor --locked
    rustup component add llvm-tools-preview

# Install the pinned toolchain and the moon-managed git hooks
setup:
    proto install
    moon sync vcs-hooks

# Build the workspace. One `cargo --workspace` invocation, not `moon run :build`: per-crate cargo processes all
# contend for the same target/ lock and serialize.
build:
    cargo build --workspace --locked

build-release:
    cargo build --workspace --release --locked

# Run tests with nextest, plus doctests, which nextest does not run. The default-features pass catches code that only
# builds because --all-features turned something on.
test:
    cargo nextest run --workspace --all-features --locked
    cargo nextest run --workspace --locked
    cargo test --doc --workspace --all-features --locked

# Line coverage; fails below the threshold, which this default owns
coverage threshold="90":
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    cargo llvm-cov nextest --workspace --all-features --locked --lcov --output-path lcov.info
    cargo llvm-cov report --summary-only --fail-under-lines "{{ threshold }}"

# Coverage report, opened in the browser
coverage-html:
    cargo llvm-cov nextest --workspace --all-features --locked --html --open

# Format check, clippy with and without default features, and typos, the same as CI's lint job
lint: typos
    cargo fmt --all --check
    cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings
    cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --no-default-features --locked -- -D warnings

# Clippy on the crates moon reports as affected, in one cargo invocation
lint-affected:
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    projects=$(moon query projects --affected | jq -r '.projects[].id')
    if [ -z "$projects" ]; then exit 0; fi
    args=()
    for p in $projects; do args+=(-p "$p"); done
    cargo clippy "${args[@]}" --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings

fmt:
    cargo fmt --all

# Documentation build, with warnings (including broken intra-doc links) as errors
doc-check:
    RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps --workspace --all-features --locked
    RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps --workspace --locked

# Licenses, advisories, bans and sources
deny:
    cargo deny check

# Unused dependencies
machete:
    cargo machete

typos:
    typos

# Callisto config, package discovery and pending changesets, plus the wording rules of CONTRIBUTING.md's "Writing a changeset"; the same gate as CI's Changesets job
changesets:
    callisto status --check --strict
    callisto release --dry-run --format text
    python3 -I scripts/test_check_changesets.py
    python3 -I scripts/check-changesets.py

# Record a pending change for the next release, e.g. `just changeset minor "Add the search command"`
changeset bump summary:
    callisto add --package cargo/monokl:{{ bump }} --summary "{{ summary }}"

# Workflow audit for permission, credential and supply-chain issues
zizmor:
    zizmor --offline --strict-collection .

# Fails when a duplicated fact disagrees with its owner, e.g. the Callisto pin in the workflows against .prototools
check-drift:
    scripts/check-drift.sh

# Checks a published release is complete and usable, e.g. `just verify-release 0.4.0`. Needs network and gh.
verify-release version:
    scripts/verify-release.sh {{ version }}

# Score search targeting and output size against ripgrep on pinned public repos. Needs network and `rg`; on demand, not part of `just ci`.
rg-compare *args:
    cargo build --release -q
    python3 -I scripts/rg-compare.py {{ args }}

# Bytes, estimated tokens and turns of one `monokl search` against a fixed rg-only agent policy on the rg-compare questions; deterministic, no model. Report only. Needs network and `rg`; on demand.
agent-cost *args:
    cargo build --release -q
    python3 -I scripts/test_agent_cost.py
    python3 -I scripts/agent-cost.py {{ args }}

# Time and peak memory of `monokl search` against ripgrep on pinned repos and a stress set. Warm cache; needs network and `rg`; on demand.
bench *args:
    cargo build --release -q
    python3 -I scripts/bench.py {{ args }}

# Block span and parent invariants over the harness repositories in target/rg-compare (`just rg-compare` fills it) or the directories in MONOKL_SPAN_CORPUS; skips with a message when neither exists. On demand.
span-invariants:
    cargo test -p monokl --test span_invariants --release -- --ignored --nocapture

# Mutation testing. Slow, so on demand only, not part of `just ci`.
mutants:
    cargo mutants --workspace

# Public API SemVer check against the last published version. Not in `just ci` until a first release exists.
check-api:
    cargo semver-checks check-release

clean:
    moon clean 2>/dev/null || true
    cargo clean

# Run by the moon-managed pre-commit hook
pre-commit:
    cargo fmt --all --check
    typos

# Run by the moon-managed pre-push hook
pre-push: pre-commit lint-affected

# Everything the CI jobs run
ci: lint test doc-check deny machete typos zizmor check-drift changesets coverage

toolUseResult.originalFile:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  merge_group:

permissions:
  contents: read

# Pull requests cancel their own superseded runs. A push to main or a merge group gets a group per commit: GitHub keeps
# one pending run per group and cancels the rest, which would leave a merged commit unchecked.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.ref || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1

# Each job runs `just` recipes, so `just ci` locally does what CI does.
jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: rust
        run: |
          version=$(sed -n 's/^rust = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' .prototools)
          test -n "$version"
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.rust.outputs.version }}
          components: clippy,rustfmt
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2.90.3
        with:
          tool: just,cargo-machete,typos
      - run: just lint doc-check machete typos

  test:
    name: Test / ${{ matrix.os }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: rust
        run: |
          version=$(sed -n 's/^rust = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' .prototools)
          test -n "$version"
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.rust.outputs.version }}
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2.90.3
        with:
          tool: just,cargo-nextest
      - run: just test

  msrv:
    name: MSRV
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: msrv
        run: echo "version=$(sed -n 's/^rust-version = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' Cargo.toml)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.msrv.outputs.version }}
      - run: cargo check --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked

  coverage:
    name: Coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: rust
        run: |
          version=$(sed -n 's/^rust = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' .prototools)
          test -n "$version"
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.rust.outputs.version }}
          components: llvm-tools-preview
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2.90.3
        with:
          tool: just,cargo-nextest,cargo-llvm-cov
      - run: just coverage
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        if: always()
        with:
          name: coverage
          path: lcov.info
          retention-days: 14

  audit:
    name: Audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2.90.3
        with:
          tool: just,cargo-deny,zizmor@1.29.0
      - run: just deny zizmor check-drift

  changesets:
    name: Changesets
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/callisto-validate@9234c02c00f65c7b742da4f4dd8b9fdbfbb0215a # callisto@0.22.0
      - run: python3 -I scripts/test_check_changesets.py
      - run: python3 -I scripts/check-changesets.py

  # The one check to require in branch protection.
  ci:
    name: CI
    needs: [lint, test, msrv, coverage, audit, changesets]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - if: contains(needs.*.result, 'failure') || contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled')
        run: exit 1

  # Runs only after a merge. The merge queue should keep main green; this catches whatever slips past it.
  main-red:
    name: Main is red
    needs: [ci]
    if: always() && github.event_name == 'push' && needs.ci.result == 'failure'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
    steps:
      - env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
          SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          body="CI failed on main at $SHA: $RUN_URL"
          number=$(gh issue list --label ci-red --state open --json number --jq '.[0].number // empty')
          if [ -n "$number" ]; then
            gh issue comment "$number" --body "$body"
          else
            gh label create ci-red --color B60205 --description "CI failed on main" 2>/dev/null || true
            gh issue create --label ci-red --title "CI is red on main" --body "$body"
          fi
          echo "::error::$body"
          exit 1

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  merge_group:

permissions:
  contents: read

# Pull requests cancel their own superseded runs. A push to main or a merge group gets a group per commit: GitHub keeps
# one pending run per group and cancels the rest, which would leave a merged commit unchecked.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.ref || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1

# Each job runs `just` recipes, so `just ci` locally does what CI does.
jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: rust
        run: |
          version=$(sed -n 's/^rust = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' .prototools)
          test -n "$version"
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.rust.outputs.version }}
          components: clippy,rustfmt
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2.90.3
        with:
          tool: just,cargo-machete,typos
      - run: just lint doc-check machete typos

  test:
    name: Test / ${{ matrix.os }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: rust
        run: |
          version=$(sed -n 's/^rust = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' .prototools)
          test -n "$version"
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.rust.outputs.version }}
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2.90.3
        with:
          tool: just,cargo-nextest
      - run: just test

  msrv:
    name: MSRV
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: msrv
        run: echo "version=$(sed -n 's/^rust-version = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' Cargo.toml)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.msrv.outputs.version }}
      - run: cargo check --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked

  coverage:
    name: Coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: rust
        run: |
          version=$(sed -n 's/^rust = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' .prototools)
          test -n "$version"
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.rust.outputs.version }}
          components: llvm-tools-preview
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2.90.3
        with:
          tool: just,cargo-nextest,cargo-llvm-cov
      - run: just coverage
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        if: always()
        with:
          name: coverage
          path: lcov.info
          retention-days: 14

  audit:
    name: Audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2.90.3
        with:
          tool: just,cargo-deny,zizmor@1.29.0
      - run: just deny zizmor check-drift

  changesets:
    name: Changesets
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/callisto-validate@9234c02c00f65c7b742da4f4dd8b9fdbfbb0215a # callisto@0.22.0
      # A pull request that changes a package must carry a changeset. A merge group's base is the pull request's own and
      # the release PR consumes the changesets, so neither is checked.
      - if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.head_ref != 'callisto/version-packages'
        run: callisto status --check --strict --since origin/main
      - run: python3 -I scripts/test_check_changesets.py
      - run: python3 -I scripts/check-changesets.py

  # The one check to require in branch protection.
  ci:
    name: CI
    needs: [lint, test, msrv, coverage, audit, changesets]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - if: contains(needs.*.result, 'failure') || contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled')
        run: exit 1

  # Runs only after a merge. The merge queue should keep main green; this catches whatever slips past it.
  main-red:
    name: Main is red
    needs: [ci]
    if: always() && github.event_name == 'push' && needs.ci.result == 'failure'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
    steps:
      - env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
          SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          body="CI failed on main at $SHA: $RUN_URL"
          number=$(gh issue list --label ci-red --state open --json number --jq '.[0].number // empty')
          if [ -n "$number" ]; then
            gh issue comment "$number" --body "$body"
          else
            gh label create ci-red --color B60205 --description "CI failed on main" 2>/dev/null || true
            gh issue create --label ci-red --title "CI is red on main" --body "$body"
          fi
          echo "::error::$body"
          exit 1

## Where things stand

See [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md#current-state).

## Proposing a change

- A spec correction: fix the spec file and add a dated entry to `docs/spec/05-research-and-decisions.md`.
- A decision with a credible alternative that is expensive to reverse: write an ADR (`docs/adr/0000-template.md`).
- Everything else: a PR with a Conventional Commits title.

Conventions are in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). Highlights: no `unwrap()`/`expect()`/`panic!()` outside tests, one `thiserror` error enum, owned data out of every parse, `camino` paths, 120-column formatting, and no spec IDs in code.

## Pull requests

- CI's aggregate `CI` check must pass: lint, tests on Linux and macOS, MSRV, line coverage, audit and changesets. The same checks run on the merge queue's combined commit and again on every push to main; a red main opens or updates a `ci-red` issue.
- Keep a PR to one topic.
- A change users can see needs a changeset. Internal changes (tests, CI, docs, refactors) do not.

## Writing a changeset

Each changeset becomes one bullet in the changelog. Each version lists its bullets under `Major Changes`, `Minor Changes` and `Patch Changes` headings, below the release date and a compare link. The release PR titles each change by its first line and collapses the rest.

- **One topic per file** in `.changeset/`, with `monokl: minor` for a new capability or `monokl: patch` for a fix.
- **Entries appear in filename order within their bump heading.** Prefix a filename with `0-` (then `1-`) to make an entry lead its heading.
- **Put identifiers, flags and syntax in backticks.**
- `just changesets` validates them. The rendered text only shows in the release PR, so read it there before merging.

Changesets become the project's changelog, so write them for the people who use it, not for the implementer. Write for the user of the CLI first; a Rust library user reads the last sentence.

- Open with a bold lead-in naming the change as the user sees it, then one line of value in plain words: what they can now do or what changed for them.

A trail captures project intent across repositories and branches. Manage intent and discussions on the whole trail; use --repo and --branch to select context for checkout, sessions, findings, and approvals.

Usage:
  entire trail [flags]
  entire trail [command]

Available Commands:
  approvals       List approval decisions on a trail
  approve         Approve a trail
  attachment      Upload, list, and remove images for a trail's description
  checkout        Check out a trail's branch
  ci-pr           Create or link the GitHub pull request that runs CI
  comment         Discuss the whole trail across repositories
  create          Create a trail and publish its branch
  finding         Manage a trail's agent findings
  link            Link a repository branch to a trail
  list            List trails in a project
  merge           Merge one of a trail's changes into its base
  ready           Mark a trail ready for review
  rerun-review    Review a trail's current head again
  resume          Resume a trail's agent session
  retarget        Change the base branch a trail merges into
  sessions        List the agent sessions behind a trail's commits
  show            Show trail intent and its repositories and branches
  stack           Show the pull request stack a trail belongs to
  timeline        Show a trail's activity: commits, reviews, findings, and approvals
  unlink          Unlink a repository branch without deleting its work
  update          Update project intent and lifecycle
  update-branch   Merge the base branch into a trail's branch
  watch           Tail events for a trail's selected repository branch

Flags:
  -h, --help[=true|false]   help for trail
      --project string      Project as gh/<owner> or et/<project>; required for list, otherwise defaults to the repository's namespace
      --repo string         Target repository as forge/owner/repo (e.g. gh/acme/app) or a clone URL; for list, only filters the required --project

Global Flags:
      --context name   Act as this saved login name for this command only — including the git and agent processes it spawns — instead of the active context (entire auth contexts lists them)

Use "entire trail [command] --help" for more information about a command.

    monokl/95          main  merged  https://entire.com/gh/orin-dx/-/trails/371/changes/monokl/95

Description:
Outcome: a release of monokl can be planned, previewed and verified before and after it ships, on the current Callisto, and the changelog reads well for users.
Done when: the Callisto pin, the release action and the generated workflow agree on one version; just verify-release passes for the latest tag; the release PR lists breaking changes up front; the changeset convention matches the changelog layout.
Learned: the release workflow failed once on a detached-HEAD precondition (E170) that nothing rehearsed; the generated workflow, the action pins and .prototools must move together; a changeset's first sentence is the changelog line.
Changes: release workflow fix (#49), verify-release (#53), Callisto upgrade to 0.20.

**Merge after 0.8.0 is published.** The release PR (#119) and its branch are untouched. Merging this first would run monokl's first release on a workflow no release has exercised.

This draft pull request was opened by [Entire](https://entire.com) to back a trail. Feel free to edit the title or body, but keep the hidden marker below: Entire uses it to close this pull request when the trail closes.

<!-- entire-shadow-pr -->

## What changed

Callisto 0.20.0 to 0.22.0 (trail 371).

- **Pins:** `.prototools` (version and plugin commit), every `uses:` and `version:` in `.github/workflows/*.yml`, all on `callisto@0.22.0` = `9234c02c00f65c7b742da4f4dd8b9fdbfbb0215a` (the tag's commit, dereferenced). Release action and tool are on one version. 0.22.0 binary installed and used for every check below.
- **`callisto.toml`:** four `[[release.artifact]]` blocks and `forge-repository` become `targets = [...]` plus `asset-name = "monokl-{target}.tar.gz"`. The four names are byte-identical to the assets of `monokl@0.7.0` (`gh release view`) and to `callisto matrix` output.
- **Workflow:** `.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml` regenerated with `callisto init --workflow` in a scratch repo with the same `callisto.toml`. Every local deviation of 0.20 (`ref: github.sha` checkouts, the `artipacked` zizmor ignore) is now generated, so nothing local is kept except one.
- **Kept deviation:** `verification: require` on all five `setup-callisto` steps. 0.22 still supports the input but defaults to `fallback`, which installs Callisto from crates.io when the attestation check fails; `require` aborts instead. Verified that the 0.22.0 release asset carries an attestation (`gh attestation verify`), so `require` can pass.
- **`scripts/verify-release.sh`:** read `forge-repository` and counted `[[release.artifact]]` blocks, both gone. It now takes the repository from `origin` and requires the release's asset names to equal `asset-name` over `targets` exactly (stronger than the old count).
- **`scripts/check-drift.sh`:** its `callisto@<digits>` pattern would have matched the commit hash `9234c02...` inside `setup-callisto@9234c02...` as a version (latent: 0.20's hash started with a letter). Now requires `X.Y.Z`.
- **Changeset check:** CI runs `callisto status --check --strict --since origin/main` on pull requests, and `just changesets` runs it too. It covers what `scripts/check-changesets.py` cannot (that checks wording): a PR that changes the crate with no changeset. I probed it: a one-line edit to `crates/monokl/src/lib.rs` fails with `monokl changed since origin/main and no changeset names it`. The wording checks from #122 are unchanged. The CI step is skipped for the release PR (it deletes changesets, and the check fails on it: tested against `callisto/version-packages`) and for merge groups. **Convention change for the owner:** CONTRIBUTING and the PR template now say a crate change with no visible effect needs a `none` changeset (`just changeset none "..."`); before, "tests, CI, docs, refactors" needed none. Docs and CI changes outside the crate still need none. Revert the last commit's CI and justfile lines if you prefer the old rule.

## Release workflow review (as a reviewer, line by line)

- Workflow `permissions: {}`; each job states its own.
- `plan`, `build`, `build-python`, `package-cargo`, `pack-npm`: `contents: read`, no secrets, `persist-credentials: false`. All code from the repository (builds, build scripts, proc macros) runs only here.
- `attest`: the only job besides `execute` with `id-token: write`; no checkout and no `run` step, only `download-artifact` and `attest-build-provenance`. The old `build` job held `id-token` and `attestations: write` next to the build; it no longer does.
- `execute`: `contents: write`, `id-token: write`, `attestations: read`. The only secret, `CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN`, is in the env of the one step that runs `callisto release execute`, which publishes with `cargo publish --no-verify` (compiled beforehand by `package-cargo`). Its checkout keeps credentials for the tag push (zizmor ignore, as before). `id-token: write` is generated for OIDC publishing, which this crates.io and GitHub-release only repo does not use; kept as generated.
- `version-pr`: `contents: write, pull-requests: write`, no registry secret; now runs after `plan` and `execute` so that it never re-infers commits that are being released.
- Trigger is unchanged: push to `main`, and `plan` sets `release=true` only when `HEAD` adds or changes `.callisto/release-decision.json`. The attestation policy in the intent names `.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml` at the orchestration revision, still our file.
- npm, PyPI, Yarn and Bun changes in 0.22: not applicable (crates.io and GitHub release only; `has_npm` and `has_python` are false for a monokl release, so `pack-npm` and `build-python` skip). The `[registries.cratesIo]`, `[[package-set]]` and `nuget` breaking changes do not touch our config.
- zizmor: no findings. Its auditor persona reports the pre-existing `secrets-outside-env` (the Cargo token is a repository secret, not an environment secret) and some `undocumented-permissions`; neither is new.

## Checks run (all by exit code)

`just check-drift`, `just zizmor`, `just typos`, `just changesets`, `callisto status --check --strict` (exit 0), `callisto release --dry-run` (exit 0, "Nothing to release" because no release commit is pending), `just verify-release 0.7.0` (all `ok`), and `just ci`'s members: lint, test, doc-check, deny, machete, typos, zizmor, check-drift, changesets and coverage (98.90% lines). `just deny` needs the network and exits 1 inside the sandbox; it passed outside it. Also run with the 0.22.0 binary against the release PR's head commit (detached, nothing changed): `callisto release plan --from-release-commit` accepts the real 0.8.0 decision, and the slots carry the four expected assets and the attestation policy.

## Not rehearsed

The real publish, the attestation, and the new job split (`attest`, `package-cargo` and the `version-pr` ordering) run only in an actual release. The plan stage was rehearsed against the real release PR (above), nothing after it.

## After the first release on this workflow (0.9.0 or whichever follows)

In the Actions run of the release commit's push to `main`:

1. `plan` has `release=true`; its matrix output holds four cargo entries; `has_cargo=true`, `has_npm=false`, `has_python=false`.
2. Four `build` jobs pass. `attest` passes and lists four subjects (`monokl-*.tar.gz`). `package-cargo` passes. `build-python` and `pack-npm` are skipped.
3. `execute` passes. Its "Execute the release" log shows `cargo publish --no-verify` for monokl, the tag push, the GitHub release and four uploads. It has `contents: write` and the Cargo token only.
4. `version-pr` runs after `execute` and does not open a stray release PR for the commits just released.
5. `just verify-release <version>` prints `ok` for: the tag on origin, a published non-draft release, exactly the four assets named by `callisto.toml`, crates.io max version equal to `<version>`, a verifying attestation for the host's asset, the binary version and the fixture search.
6. Optional: `gh attestation verify monokl-<target>.tar.gz --repo orin-dx/monokl` for each target, to confirm the `attest` job's attestations cover all four.

If a job fails, the release is partial: check crates.io and the tag before re-running.

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  merge_group:

permissions:
  contents: read

# Pull requests cancel their own superseded runs. A push to main or a merge group gets a group per commit: GitHub keeps
# one pending run per group and cancels the rest, which would leave a merged commit unchecked.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.ref || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1

# Each job runs `just` recipes, so `just ci` locally does what CI does.
jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: rust
        run: |
          version=$(sed -n 's/^rust = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' .prototools)
          test -n "$version"
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.rust.outputs.version }}
          components: clippy,rustfmt
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2.90.3
        with:
          tool: just,cargo-machete,typos
      - run: just lint doc-check machete typos

  test:
    name: Test / ${{ matrix.os }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: rust
        run: |
          version=$(sed -n 's/^rust = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' .prototools)
          test -n "$version"
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.rust.outputs.version }}
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2.90.3
        with:
          tool: just,cargo-nextest
      - run: just test

  msrv:
    name: MSRV
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: msrv
        run: echo "version=$(sed -n 's/^rust-version = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' Cargo.toml)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.msrv.outputs.version }}
      - run: cargo check --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked

  coverage:
    name: Coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: rust
        run: |
          version=$(sed -n 's/^rust = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' .prototools)
          test -n "$version"
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.rust.outputs.version }}
          components: llvm-tools-preview
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2.90.3
        with:
          tool: just,cargo-nextest,cargo-llvm-cov
      - run: just coverage
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        if: always()
        with:
          name: coverage
          path: lcov.info
          retention-days: 14

  audit:
    name: Audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2.90.3
        with:
          tool: just,cargo-deny,zizmor@1.29.0
      - run: just deny zizmor check-drift

  changesets:
    name: Changesets
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/callisto-validate@9234c02c00f65c7b742da4f4dd8b9fdbfbb0215a # callisto@0.22.0
      # A pull request that changes a package must carry a changeset. Skipped for the release PR, which consumes them, and
      # in a merge group, where the pull request was already checked.
      - if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.head_ref != 'callisto/version-packages'
        run: callisto status --check --strict --since origin/main
      - run: python3 -I scripts/test_check_changesets.py
      - run: python3 -I scripts/check-changesets.py

  # The one check to require in branch protection.
  ci:
    name: CI
    needs: [lint, test, msrv, coverage, audit, changesets]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - if: contains(needs.*.result, 'failure') || contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled')
        run: exit 1

  # Runs only after a merge. The merge queue should keep main green; this catches whatever slips past it.
  main-red:
    name: Main is red
    needs: [ci]
    if: always() && github.event_name == 'push' && needs.ci.result == 'failure'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
    steps:
      - env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
          SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          body="CI failed on main at $SHA: $RUN_URL"
          number=$(gh issue list --label ci-red --state open --json number --jq '.[0].number // empty')
          if [ -n "$number" ]; then
            gh issue comment "$number" --body "$body"
          else
            gh label create ci-red --color B60205 --description "CI failed on main" 2>/dev/null || true
            gh issue create --label ci-red --title "CI is red on main" --body "$body"
          fi
          echo "::error::$body"
          exit 1
